summary: Late-1940s standard 100-foot lookout in Marion County, now on private land; the Register's administrator field conflicts with the Forestry Commission credit; NHLR-registered 2016.

access.note: The Register says the site is now private property. The description's writer did not have permission to climb the tower.

corrections.why: The Register says the site is now private property; the cited sources do not support state ownership.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved agency conflict: the Register's 'Administered by' field names Charles Daniel Mullins, its description says the tower was built for the Alabama Forestry Commission, and Forest Lookouts names the Forestry Commission. Left out of facts.agency pending a human look; the record's agency field is unchanged. The Register gives only 'late 1940s' for the build, so no built event was added. The condition description is undated. Web searches found no other source on this tower or its owner. The ownership correction is for human review.
